checkedAlternates.risk: Nano is a negative-exponent SI prefix like milli and centi.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Nano (10^-9) is isolated in the nanoscale tier (group-1), distinct from the everyday millimeter/centimeter sub-units (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Kilobyte is often grouped with megabyte and gigabyte in computing.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Kilo is 10^3 and belongs to the small multiples tier 10^1–10^3 (group-3), whereas mega through peta span 10^6–10^15 (group-4).
